findings.conclusion: The route mounts @fm/ratan_cashflow_blotter inside RatanProvider and PageContainer under MfeThemeProvider.
findings.consequence: The wrapper and its mounted header are part of the idle investigation.
findings.next_action: Bind the deployed route and modules to these source bytes.

findings.conclusion: Provider registration, theme configuration, and initial navigation do not start a recurring request in the inspected code.
findings.consequence: These wrappers do not supply a demonstrated recurring renewal source.
findings.next_action: Keep runtime call tracing open for any different deployed wrapper.

findings.conclusion: PageContainer starts a 300-millisecond loading timer for each refreshState change. Status performs one mount-time monitor GET.
findings.consequence: No periodic authentication renewal is shown by these header paths.
findings.next_action: Record mount counts and response headers if repeated remounts or monitor traffic appear.
findings.limit: A remount can repeat the monitor call. This inspection does not determine that response header or backend behavior.

findings.conclusion: Shared init retrieves cached fields or versions when called. The authenticator reads the shared user state.
findings.consequence: Names such as autoRefreshFields do not establish a timed refresh loop.
findings.next_action: Trace callers if repeated field requests appear in runtime evidence.

findings.conclusion: Query completion calls ExtendTokenService. Subscription reconnect handlers schedule bounded reconnection attempts without that direct extension call.
findings.consequence: Repeated queries can renew access, but this wrapper supplies no demonstrated periodic query cadence.
findings.next_action: Correlate actual query completions and access-extension responses.
findings.limit: Subscription events or downstream callers can initiate queries outside this inspected wrapper scope.

findings.conclusion: Feature-gated analytics sends queued events on visibility transitions. Its wrappers record request timing without a polling interval.
findings.consequence: Analytics can cause transition-time requests, but no periodic direct session renewal was identified here.
findings.next_action: Retain analytics request and authorization-response evidence if it changes access expiry.
findings.limit: Effective feature flags and provider response headers remain unverified.

limits: Source inspection predicts client behavior only. No UAT execution occurs in this audit.
Supplied Ratan container copy has no established independent Git revision or deployed-byte binding.
This bounded audit covers mounted wrapper code. It does not prove that the embedded Blotter and all descendants never issue recurring requests.
Ordinary service responses could carry authentication headers. Their deployed behavior requires separate evidence.
